meta.name: Brownsville, TX (downtown, the border bridges, Hwy 4 start)
meta.axes: x = east, z = south (north is -z), y up; origin = bbox centre

format.names: string table; every *name field below is an index into it, -1 = unnamed
format.roads: nodes = flat [x,z,...] graph nodes (intersections, dead ends, bbox cuts); edges = [a, b, typeIdx, name, lanes, oneway(1 a→b, -1 b→a, 0 both), layer(+bridge/-tunnel), widthM, maxspeedMph(0 unknown), flat interior shape points a→b]; types = highway type table
format.buildings: [heightM, minHeightM, name, buildingType("" = generic), flat footprint ring, CCW from above, not closed]
format.paths: [highwayType, name, flat polyline] for footways/cycleways/steps (sidewalks omitted)
format.landmarks: {name, kind, x, z, node (nearest road graph node), nodeDist}
